messages.subject: Problem in Identification of copy-number regions (CNRs) Process
parts:

process. The error message look like this:
> cbs <- CbsModel(cesN)
Error in list("CbsModel(cesN)" = <environment>,
"extend(CopyNumberSegmentationModel(cesTuple = cesTuple, ...),
"CbsModel")" = <environment>, :

[2008-04-19 11:25:44] Exception: Failed to locate a genome annotation
data file: Human

fullname)

fullname)

Pls help me for analyzing CNRs for more information.

parts:
I used GWS 5 for genotyping and I have 33 normal samples for CNV
detection. I following on your provided documentation in Total Copy
Number Analysis (5.0 & 6.0). I done until PCR fragment length
normalization step and get the CnChipEffectSet:
Name: HapMap270
Tags: 5.0,CEU,testSet,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY
Path: plmData/HapMap270,5.0,CEU,testSet,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-
XY/GenomeWideSNP_5 already.
But when the process further on the identification of copy-number
regions (CNRs) step. I get the error message that mentioned above. In
process of segmentation I use CBS algorithm and command line > cbs <-
CbsModel(cesN) to analyze them. Pls help me or suggestion. I needed
your help to use aroma.affymetrix for my thesis. Thank you very much
for kindly help

Hi,

I'm not sure if you solved this already, but it looks like there is
something wrong with your installation of the aroma.affymetrix
package. Please reinstall the package by using

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbLite("aroma.affymetrix", force=TRUE)

If it does not work then, what does you get if you do:

library(aroma.affymetrix);
path <- system.file("annotationData", package="aroma.affymetrix");
print(path);
## [1] "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-2.7.0pat/library/aroma.affymetrix/annotationData"
print(list.files(path, recursive=TRUE));
## [1] "genomes/Human/Human,chromosomes.txt"

It is that file aroma.affymetrix cannot find. If it is there and it
still does not work, you can always copy that file to:

annotationData/genomes/Human/Human,chromosomes.txt

in the working directory. (This is actually how you can override the
default annotation file).

Let us know how it goes.

/Henrik
